semantics.claims: Canonical claim records from the TRUST v2 claim graph.
semantics.relations: Claim-citation contexts exported without changing their evidence role.
semantics.trust: Original claim-level five-component scores retained as source aggregates; all Oratlas relation-level criteria explicitly remain not assessed.
semantics.humanReview: A relation is marked human-reviewed when its canonical claim text occurs in an approved human-review override decision.
